labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for new styling behaviour in ReprHighlighter; Rich has no unit highlighting, so this is a feature request.

body:
Feature requests need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start the proposal for styling units in `ReprHighlighter` there.

Until then, you can already style units without changing Rich by subclassing `RegexHighlighter`, as shown in [Custom Highlighters](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst). A related open report about number highlighting is #3318.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
